# Tevis Engineering Solutions

> Veteran-owned IT support, software and engineering firm in Cleveland, Ohio.
> Managed IT and help desk for small businesses, custom software and websites,
> and product engineering: PCB design, CAD and mechanical design, 3D printing,
> and replacement parts. Founded by Tyler Tevis, an Air Force veteran and
> computer engineer. Not affiliated with TES Engineering, the MEP firm in Westlake.

## What we do
- Managed IT support and help desk for small businesses, on-site and remote: https://tevisengineering.com/how_support_works.html
- Engineering services: product design, PCB design, CAD and mechanical design, 3D printing, prototypes and replacement parts: https://tevisengineering.com/engineering-services-cleveland.html
  - Replacement and discontinued parts, measured, modeled in CAD and 3D printed: https://tevisengineering.com/replacement-parts-cleveland.html
- Web design, web apps and customer portals: https://tevisengineering.com/website_creation.html
- Software products: https://tevisengineering.com/software.html
  - Ohio crash report leads for law firms: https://tevisengineering.com/ohio-crash-report-analysis-tool.html
  - ShingleAI roof estimate tool for roofers: https://tevisengineering.com/shingleai-roof-estimate-tool.html
  - 3D Shed Builder for shed dealers: https://tevisengineering.com/3d-shed-builder-tool.html
  - Website Watch uptime monitoring: https://tevisengineering.com/website-watch.html
  - Bid management software for Ohio public contracts: https://tevisengineering.com/bid-management-software.html
  - Cleveland Geo Visualizer, a free map of Cleveland open data: https://tevisengineering.com/cleveland-geo-visualizer.html
- Data destruction (NIST-aligned media sanitization): https://tevisengineering.com/data_destruction.html
- Knowledge transfer and IT documentation: https://tevisengineering.com/knowledge_transfer.html
- Office setup and IT equipment: https://tevisengineering.com/office-setup.html
- Free website analysis: https://tevisengineering.com/free-website-analysis.html

## Where we work
Cleveland and Northeast Ohio. On-site service in Cleveland, Lakewood, Parma,
Westlake, Rocky River, Strongsville, Independence, Solon, Beachwood, Mentor,
Cleveland Heights, Shaker Heights and University Heights. Remote support and design work for clients anywhere.
Service areas: https://tevisengineering.com/service-areas.html

## Hours
Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm Eastern.

## Pricing
- Standard engineering rate: $80 per hour. Every job is scoped and quoted before work starts.
- Engineering projects: a $50 per hour technical consultation, credited to the project, then a written statement of work. Projects up to $5,000 bill 50/50; larger projects bill 40/30/30 at milestones.
- Website Watch: $12 per month or $120 per year per site.
- Full rate card with starting prices: https://tevisengineering.com/service_catalog.html
- Pricing sheet: https://tevisengineering.com/pricing_sheet.html
